name: Richard Gere
role: American actor and activist (Tibet, human rights, HIV/AIDS prevention)
summary: Gere is an actor whose public political activity centres on Tibet: he chairs the board of the International Campaign for Tibet, has criticised Chinese rule there, and called for a boycott of the 2008 Beijing Olympics. He has also spoken in support of migrants stranded at sea and against Israeli settlement expansion. His stated views are specific advocacy causes and do not address the test's statements directly.
